subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Telegram-only `unknownGroupAction` config now, or hold this for the broader group pairing and security posture design tracked by related issues?
rationale: The PR adds new fail-closed operator behavior and config surface in a security-sensitive channel path, while related open issues ask for broader cross-channel group approval and auto-leave behavior.

options.title: Sponsor Telegram-only config
options.body: Accept the direction but require the PR to fix the authorization/threading gaps, rebase cleanly, document the new config, and provide live Telegram proof.

options.title: Fold into broader group pairing
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of the broader group-pairing and group-join security design so Telegram, WhatsApp, and other channels share the same product model.

options.title: Keep current allowlist behavior
options.body: Decline the new config surface for now and keep unknown groups blocked silently by existing allowlist policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Telegram-only config
recommendation.body: Accept the direction but require the PR to fix the authorization/threading gaps, rebase cleanly, document the new config, and provide live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent group-access and plugin-boundary history makes this the strongest available routing owner for the config and authorization decision.
